title: सुशासनका लागि डिजिटल मुद्रा तथा विद्युतीय भुक्तानी प्रणाली {Digital Currency and Electronic Payment System for Governance}
nepali: वस्तु तथा सेवाको विनिमयमा विश्वभर नै प्रयोग हुने वस्तु मुद्रा हो। कुनैपनि देशको आर्थिक प्रणाली त्यस देशको मुद्रा तथा भुक्तानी प्रणालीमा प्रत्यक्ष निर्भर रहेको हुन्छ। नेपाल लगायत विश्वभरी परम्परादेखि नै नोट तथा सिक्काको रुपमा भौतिक मुद्राको प्रयोग हुँदै आएको पाइन्छ तर पछिल्लो समयमा क्रिप्टोकरेन्सीको प्रयोग समेत बढ्दै गएको छ भने केन्द्रीय बैंकले निष्काशन गर्ने डिजिटल मुद्राको प्रयोग पनि बढ्दो छ। नेपाल लगायत विश्वका अधिकांश मुलुकहरुमा हालको भौतिक मुद्रा बैंक खातामा राखी सो बराबरको रकम विभिन्न प्लेटफार्म प्रयोग गरी विद्युतीय माध्यमबाट कारोबार तथा रकम भुक्तानी हुने गरेको पाइन्छ। कुनैपनि विनिमयमा कारोबार तथा भुक्तानी हुने भौतिक मुद्राको प्रयोग हुँदा यसको गलत प्रयोग हुन सक्ने, गैरकानुनी तवरले रकम नगदको रुपमा व्यक्तिले राख्न सक्ने गुन्जायस रहन्छ तर डिजिटल मुद्राको अवलम्बन गरी शतप्रतिशत विद्युतीय माध्यमबाट भुक्तानी तथा कारोबार हुन सकेमा सबै कारोबार कानुनी दायरामा आइ सरकारको कर प्रणालीमा सुधार हुने, राजस्व वृद्धि हुने तथा भ्रष्टाचार नियन्त्रण हुन टेवा पुग्ने देखिन्छ। यो लेख तयार गर्दा राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय रुपमा प्रकाशित लेख रचनाहरु एवम् विभिन्न प्रतिवेदनको अध्ययन तथा विश्लेषण गरी डिजिटल मुद्राको प्रयोग सुरुवात गरेका केही राष्ट्रहरुले यस्तो प्रणाली लागु गरेपश्चात प्राप्त गरेका पृष्ठपोषण र सुधारका प्रयासहरुको समेत अध्ययन गरी निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ।
american_english: Money is the item used throughout the world in the exchange of goods and services. The economic system of any country depends directly on that country's currency and payment system. It is found that physical money in the form of notes and coins has been in use since ancient times throughout Nepal and the rest of the world, but recently the use of cryptocurrency has also been increasing, and the use of digital currency issued by central banks is also growing. In most countries of the world, including Nepal, it is found that the present physical money is kept in bank accounts and equivalent amounts are transacted and payments made electronically through various platforms. When physical money is used in any transaction and payment, there is a possibility of its misuse, and an opportunity remains for a person to hold money illegally in cash, but if the adoption of digital currency enables payments and transactions to be carried out one hundred percent electronically, all transactions would come within the legal ambit, improving the government's tax system, increasing revenue, and helping to control corruption. In preparing this article, nationally and internationally published writings and various reports were studied and analyzed, and the feedback received and improvement efforts of some countries that have started using digital currency after implementing such a system were also studied, and conclusions were drawn.

informal_english: Money is the stuff used all over the world to buy and sell goods and services, eh. Any country's economy depends straight on its currency and payment system. It's found that physical money — notes and coins — has been used since way back throughout Nepal and the rest of the world, but lately crypto's been taking off too, and digital currency put out by central banks is on the rise as well. In most countries, Nepal included, it's found that today's physical money sits in bank accounts and matching amounts get moved around and paid electronically through all sorts of platforms. When physical money's used in a transaction or payment, it can be misused, and there's room for someone to stash cash illegally, but if we go fully digital with digital currency so payments and transactions are one hundred percent electronic, every transaction would come under the law, fixing up the government's tax system, lifting revenue and helping to get corruption under control. In putting this article together, nationally and internationally published writings and various reports were studied and analysed, and the feedback and improvement efforts of a few countries that have started using digital currency after rolling out such a system were also studied, and conclusions were drawn.
